sentiment.rationale: This is a pre-earnings digest, so the guidance-change framework does not apply; instead, the score reflects whether market expectations are stretched or depressed heading into the print. The digest describes a balanced-to-slightly-positive setup: pricing power is sustained, the project backlog is strong (~$10B+), and clean energy provides long-term catalysts, but it also notes volume headwinds and a softer macro environment, with no indication that the bar has been either raised or lowered. The positive operational momentum (leadership change, hydrogen pipeline expansion, helium stabilization) supports a mildly positive score, but the absence of any commentary on valuation stretch or estimate revisions keeps it below +0.3.
